narr: A cold front moved through the combined Panhandles early in the morning of April 29th. Storms developed ahead of the front and some produced severe hail and wind. Heavy rainfall led to some flash flooding. As a weather disturbance crossed the region during the afternoon of April 30th, a few storms became strong to severe.
ev: At least four to five inches of flowing water occurred across the intersection of FM2391 and County Line Road.
Heavy rainfall resulted in up to eight inches of standing water along 23rd and 25th avenues on the north side of Pampa.
